firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate fish is the starting player.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player chooses a starting set first and also takes the first turn. Other players follow clockwise.
The advanced wagon variant keeps this starting instruction. In solo play, you take every turn; there is no opponent or automa.
